checks: Other recipes show truthful prerequisites without inventing a tomato batch or enabling a press.
A real phone press previews firm resistance, then records one rejected attempt without changing food, juice, heat or time.
Softened food visibly compresses only in preview; down-only release and touch cancellation preserve its exact original state.
Press, lift and release split then crush exactly one piece, conserve its finite juice, restore the puddle and texture on reload, and prevent extra juice from repeated pressing.
The texture selector opens the exact piece in both keyboard pressing and the Food lens, with no evidence changes during navigation.
Folding blends away the local pending-juice puddles without removing liquid, undoing the chosen texture, or adding saved water.
An external burner change cancels a held masher and restores the food shape without recording an extra press.
The native press and adaptive camera work with a wide four-serving pan parked on the trivet.
The texture panel fits 320px and passes accessibility checks with forced colors and reduced motion.
